messages:
Noah (CS): FYI — Polaris Health onboarding trending down: successful completions for patient-summary flow dropped ~16% over 36h. Renewal touchpoint in 5 weeks. I want to propose a low-risk pilot: route low-impact intents to a compact int4 candidate and keep critical medical-summary routes on the current model. Can we sketch an ops-safe plan? :stethoscope:
Iris (Infra): Saw the alert. p95 latency also climbed during long-context transcripts. Quick window:
```
p50: 185ms
p95: 690ms
avg_tokens: 520
err_rate_delta: +0.7%
```
Iris (Infra): Operational constraints: must support immediate rollback, and audits for any requests that saw different outputs post-swap. We can implement gradual rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 12% with metric checks at each step.
Sam (ML): Model note: rdx-slim-int4 shows small drop on clinical-summaries rubric (~0.9% acceptability). For non-critical intents (info, routing, boilerplate) drift is <0.4%. Recommend prefix caching + token budget fallback for long generations (>750 tokens) to avoid cascade latencies.
Sam (ML): Proposed pilot:
- Candidate: rdx-slim-int4
- Canary: 2% traffic, 72h
- Ramp: 2% -> 8% at 24h if nightly_eval pass
- Eval: nightly automated metrics + 6 sampled human spot-checks/day
- Gates: auto-rollback if nightly_acceptability_drop > 1.2% OR escalations increase >8% vs baseline
ops-bot: Pilot plan created: https://internal.redwood/pilots/polaris-int4-hybrid (internal)
Iris (Infra): Routing pseudo-config (draft):
```
routing:
  - match: tag:medical_summary OR intent:escalation
    target: rdx-standard-3
  - match: else
    target: weighted(rdx-slim-int4:0.02, rdx-standard-3:0.98)
    fallback: rdx-standard-3
  - logging: trace outputs for any reranked responses
```
Noah (CS): I'll prep a two-line customer blurb highlighting protections and that we will revert on any quality signal. Can someone give a short tech sentence I can paste?
Sam (ML): Paste: "We're running a controlled, monitored pilot that routes non-critical bot intents to a compact quantized variant to improve latency stability and cost; all clinical/priority intents remain on the current model and the pilot is auto-gated by nightly quality checks and human spot-checks."
Iris (Infra): Also adding an audit log export for all canary requests so Polaris ops can review diffs; will add to the pilot doc. PagerDuty will fire on rollback. I'll set thresholds in the alert runbook.
Noah (CS): Owners: @Sam owns eval and spot-check orchestration, @Iris owns routing, rollout automation and audit export, I own customer comms + renewal note. I'll add a note in Salesforce renewal row and schedule a 15-min sync with Polaris ops for tomorrow 11am ET.
ops-bot: Canary deployed (us-west-2) at 04:22 UTC, traffic: 2%. Dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/polaris/pilot (internal)
Noah (CS): Action items: 1) Sam: push nightly eval and compile 6 human samples; 2) Iris: implement routing rule and enable audit export; 3) Noah: send blurb + invite. Will report first 24h snapshot in thread. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
